pending.test: seedStep: 3 rounds, a seed, a sprout, then a sapling, by the rounds it has left
a seed takes 3 rounds to grow, through seed, sprout and sapling, into its planter's stone
in its first round a rival's stone tramples the seed: the stone stands, the seed is gone
from its second round only its planter may play there: a rival's stone is refused
the planter may play on their own sprouting seed: the stone stands, the seed is gone
a sprouting seed is safe from rivals' items: driftwood, a lily pad and the stones items place
a Firework clears a seed in its first round, but not a sprout
lightning never strikes a sprouting seed
a seed under a fog when it is due waits a turn, as for a ko
bots read a rival's sprouting seed as reserved, as they read a rival's lily pad
Seedling says how it grows: 3 rounds, trampled only in the first
Seedling plants on an empty point for 3 rounds, and not on a stone, a seed or off the board
a seed grows on the board in three pictures: a seed, a sprout and a sapling
a seed is drawn by its step: seed, sprout, sapling, as its rounds run down
board: no stone preview over a rival's sprouting seed; a fresh seed, or my own, still offers it
